scope: PR5 ask-dismiss copy: full fresh audit of all 10 ui.chat.asks keys for vi, read side by side with en and the en context. Requested head 5b10cb570 had moved to 9571f33c5 by audit time; `git diff 5b10cb570 9571f33c5 -- src/i18n i18n` is empty, so the audited bytes are those of both heads. Cross-surface comparison against harness tui.asks/relay.ask at 93f798ddb (lo-stale-ask-surfaces, unmerged branch). No rendered-fit claim.

findings.issue: The note addresses the operator with a second-person imperative (imperative «đừng chờ đợi nữa» addressed to the reader), so it reads as telling the operator to stop waiting for a reply. Per the context sidecar the actor is the agent: dismissing means the agent stops waiting on this ask. The terminal/phone copy for the same English (tui.asks.dismiss.moot_note, relay.ask.dismiss.moot_note) was corrected for exactly this in its own independent audit and names the agent. Root cause is upstream of the translation: the en context sets `tone: "lowercase fragment, imperative"` for this key while its `note` says the agent stops waiting, so a translator following the tone line lands on an operator-addressed imperative. Coder should also change that tone line (e.g. 'lowercase fragment naming what the agent stops doing') so a re-translation does not regress.
findings.proposed: tác nhân sẽ không chờ câu trả lời nữa

findings.issue: The verb diverges from the terminal/phone surfaces («Bỏ qua câu hỏi này», «bỏ qua…», «Đã bỏ qua — …»). The desktop is also inconsistent with itself: the heading says «Gỡ», the trigger says «Gỡ bỏ…». Applies to dismiss.heading, dismiss.trigger, dismiss.receipt.moot and dismiss.receipt.answered_in_chat.
findings.current: Gỡ câu hỏi này | Gỡ bỏ… | Đã gỡ — không còn cần thiết | Đã gỡ — đã giải quyết trong chat
findings.proposed: Bỏ qua câu hỏi này | Bỏ qua… | Đã bỏ qua — không còn cần nữa | Đã bỏ qua — đã giải quyết trong cuộc trò chuyện

findings.issue: The English loan «chat» is off-corpus for the vi desktop (it appears only as a placeholder name; «cuộc trò chuyện» is used 157 times). It diverges from the terminal/phone «Đã trả lời trong cuộc trò chuyện» and from this namespace's own note. Also applies to dismiss.receipt.answered_in_chat.
findings.proposed: Đã trả lời trong cuộc trò chuyện

findings.issue: The vi style guide puts the tone mark on the FIRST vowel of open oa/uy syllables (hủy). The desktop corpus has «Hủy» 38 times and «Huỷ» 0 times.

«câu hỏi này được đặt» is not idiomatic for asking a question (it reads as 'was booked/placed'); the idiom is «được đưa ra». The bare «(gần nhất 19:36)» needs «lúc» before a clock time. «của bạn» reads more naturally than «từ bạn».
